detector-scope-peer-review-gpt4o/main.name: detector-scope-peer-review-gpt4o
detector-scope-peer-review-gpt4o/main.about: Detects GPT-4o-written reviews of machine-learning papers (trained on the AI Peer Review Detection Benchmark, human reviews vs. GPT-4o reviews). Gemma-2-2b fine-tuned as a review classifier, sparse autoencoders fine-tuned on it, and a sparse logistic-regression head over their features.
detector-scope-peer-review-gpt4o/main.variants: Branches of this repo hold the paper's other two settings on the same data: `ft-sae` (the unmodified Gemma-2-2b with the fine-tuned SAEs) and `base-sae` (the unmodified Gemma-2-2b with the Gemma Scope SAEs). Load one with `revision="ft-sae"` or `revision="base-sae"`. The general-domain detector is [detector-scope](https://huggingface.co/liamdugan/detector-scope).

detector-scope/main.name: detector-scope
detector-scope/main.about: Detects AI-generated text across domains and generators (trained on the COLING 2025 GenAI Detection shared task: news, essays, reviews and more, written by people or by 40 language models). The unmodified Gemma-2-2b, sparse autoencoders fine-tuned on this data, and a sparse logistic-regression head over their features: the best general-domain detector of the paper.
detector-scope/main.variants: Branches of this repo hold the paper's other two settings on the same data: `ft-model-sae` (Gemma-2-2b fine-tuned as a classifier, with SAEs fine-tuned on it) and `base-sae` (the unmodified Gemma-2-2b with the Gemma Scope SAEs). Load one with `revision="ft-model-sae"` or `revision="base-sae"`. For reviews of machine-learning papers use [detector-scope-peer-review-gpt4o](https://huggingface.co/liamdugan/detector-scope-peer-review-gpt4o) or [detector-scope-peer-review-llama](https://huggingface.co/liamdugan/detector-scope-peer-review-llama).
